title: FTC Warning: Fake Farm Equipment Sellers
hook: Are you looking for farm equipment online? Watch out for this sneaky impersonation scam.
description: Learn how to spot and avoid a sophisticated FTC-documented pattern where scammers impersonate legitimate farm equipment businesses online. Protect your money by verifying sellers independently. Read the full warning from the FTC here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2026/09/scammers-are-impersonating-farm-equipment-businesses

scenes.narration: Scammers are actively impersonating real farm equipment sellers online to target buyers.
scenes.heading: Fake Farm Ads
scenes.label: Illustration
scenes.evidence_quote: Scammers posing as farm equipment businesses are selling (fake) equipment to farmers

scenes.narration: They hijack trusted brand names in search results and social media feeds to build instant trust.
scenes.heading: Familiar Names
scenes.label: Illustration
scenes.evidence_quote: Or you search online and see a tractor from a business you know, and maybe even bought equipment from before.

scenes.narration: Next, they send realistic purchase agreements, demanding thousands of dollars upfront via wire transfers.
scenes.heading: The Invoice
scenes.label: Illustration
scenes.evidence_quote: They typically ask you to send thousands of dollars — usually by wire transfer — as a deposit or full payment

scenes.narration: But the delivery never arrives. Scammers cut off contact, leaving buyers empty-handed.
scenes.heading: Empty Handed
scenes.label: Illustration
scenes.evidence_quote: The delivery never comes. It turns out this was never a legit business and was all a scam.

scenes.narration: Protect yourself. Research the seller online using their name plus the word scam or complaint.
scenes.heading: Verify First
scenes.label: SOURCE: FTC
scenes.evidence_quote: Do some research by searching online for the company name plus “scam” or “complaint.”

scenes.narration: Never send money if a seller insists on wire transfers, gift cards, or cryptocurrency.
scenes.heading: Payment Rules
scenes.label: SOURCE: FTC
scenes.evidence_quote: Never send money to anyone who says you can only pay by wire transfer , gift card , cryptocurrency , or payment app .

scenes.narration: Always verify contact details independently, and report any suspicious activity directly to the FTC.
scenes.heading: Report Fraud
scenes.label: SOURCE: FTC
scenes.evidence_quote: Spot an impersonation scam? Tell the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov .

review.notes: The proposed script accurately reflects the FTC alert. It correctly identifies the scam mechanism, verification steps, and reporting procedures without adding speculative details or invented victim stories. All UI elements are appropriately labeled as illustrations.
